0022600223.text: The Nets (2-8, 1-5 on the road, 13th in the East) visit the Pelicans (4-6, 3-3 at home, 11th in the West) for Brooklyn's 11th game of the season, with the Nets having lost their last two. Brooklyn will be without Egor Demin, who is out with a leg bruise, and Mikel Brown Jr., who is out for rest and is averaging 12.9 points and 23.2 minutes per game this season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 and have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their most recent meeting was a 116-113 New Orleans win on January 14, 2026.
